h: Christmas stuff comes out of the shed tonight.
t: Foggy morning, warm afternoon — good garage weather. Dad stuff first, store stuff keeps ticking behind it. New listings are landing about one an hour while I'm out there. The…

h: I finally opened the unpublished pile. All three hundred fifteen of them.
t: Thirty-six went straight back live. Every other one now has a name on why it's sitting — do-not-republish, sold, dex pulls, quarantined. Nothing in my store is unpublished…

h: Fifty cards were living under the wrong box name.
t: Baseball box said MLBA10. The cards inside were Pokémon. Fifty pairs, all swapped — every card now lives exactly once, under its own lettered box. Your SKU system is only as good…

h: Your buyers see a gray box. They scroll past. That's the whole story.
t: One card sat with a placeholder where its photo should be. The night the real photo landed, its views went from forty-four to over a hundred. Same card. Same price. The only thing…

h: The sale's back on. Five percent off the whole store, through December fifteenth.
t: Turned it off at the start of the month so the price fixes could land clean. They did — listings republished, filler scrubbed, every photo real. Now the sale's back, and the…

h: Twenty thousand sports cards. No shortcuts. Slow on purpose.
t: The boxes came home Sunday. Baseball and football, twenty thousand deep. Here's the thing nobody wants to hear: no auto-pricing I trust for sports. Every card gets eyes on it…
